title: One person’s way through The Labs, left to right
dek: The region chart shows the parts. This map follows one participant from first hearing of us to after a Cycle, with what people told us at every step.
cover_alt: The participant journey: one thick blue line through ten steps, from hearing of The Labs to after a Cycle. Inside the Cycle the line runs through proposals that open and narrow, branching into three pods and then into projects that meet at the showcase. Red rings mark where people leave; quotes from alumni and organizers sit under each step.
